name: PM-KISAN Samman Nidhi
benefit: Income support, ₹6,000/year in three instalments for eligible farmer families

rules.text: Income tax payers (previous assessment year) in the beneficiary family - the applicant or their spouse - are excluded
Someone else in the household pays income tax. Whether this matters depends on the official definition of the beneficiary family (husband, wife and minor children) - needs a manual check
Serving or retired government employees (except MTS/Class IV/Group D) and pensioners with Rs 10,000+/month are excluded
A bank account is needed for payment
Current/former holders of constitutional posts (ministers, MPs, MLAs, mayors, district panchayat chairpersons) are excluded
Practising professionals (doctors, engineers, lawyers, CAs, architects) are excluded

documents: Aadhaar-based eKYC done on the official portal
manual_checks: Exact landholding and exclusion conditions per the official Operational Guidelines
Land ownership cut-off date: the FAQ (Q10, Q11) says 1 Feb 2019 with an exception for succession on death; ask the revenue office whether this still applies
Land must be cultivable and actually in agricultural use (FAQ Q23, Q25)
review_notes: Exclusions drafted from the operational guidelines as summarised by secondary sources (Nov 2026). An independent reviewer must check the guideline text itself, exceptions, family definition (husband, wife, minor children) and current state rules before verification. Income tax is split into applicant / spouse (exclusion) and other household members (manual-check flag): the reviewer must confirm against the family definition in the guidelines.
application_steps: Open the official portal pmkisan.gov.in (or visit your CSC / local agriculture office).
Use Farmers Corner to register as a new farmer, or check your status if you are already registered.
Keep your land record and bank passbook ready.
Complete eKYC as the portal instructs.
Write your registration number in the Applications tab of this app.
